infoPlist.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Clavis needs Accessibility permission to resolve cursor position, manage windows, and inject expanded snippets or AI output.
infoPlist.NSInputMonitoringUsageDescription: Clavis needs Input Monitoring permission to detect global Leader keys, double-tap modifiers, and inline snippet triggers.
infoPlist.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Clavis needs Apple Events permission to launch applications and inspect frontmost application context.
infoPlist.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Clavis needs Screen Recording permission to capture screen regions for annotation, OCR, and AI analysis.
